note: Open-weight models served by EU-resident hosters. Kai (ShopAgentic) scrapes these by hand because they publish no pricing API and appear in no aggregator — not OpenRouter, not Price Per Token. For compliance-constrained buyers this is the whole shortlist, and residency is a harder constraint than price. Every row is TRACKED until confirmed against the provider's own page: these are indicative rates compiled from public pricing pages and must be verified before quoting.

hosts.name: Self-hosted (own GPU)
hosts.note: Kai runs a fine-tuned Gemma 12B this way for most text work. Priced per GPU-hour, not per token — see the break-even note.

offerings.note: priced per GPU-hour; see break_even for when this beats per-token

break_even.explanation: A rented GPU costs the same whether it is busy or idle, so self-hosting wins above a volume threshold and loses below it. Break-even (tokens/month) ≈ (gpu_hour × 730) ÷ blended_per_token_rate.
break_even.worked_example: At $0.90/GPU-hour a small server costs ~$657/month. Against a hosted open model at a blended ~$0.35/M tokens, self-hosting breaks even around 1.9B tokens/month — below that, rent the API; above it, run your own.
break_even.caveat: Ignores engineering time, availability and fine-tuning cost, all of which favour the hosted option until volume is genuinely large.
